why: L1047-1050 says the original path must be tried as well; it does not exempt a self-reference. typesafe/config and zig-hocon still look back at the fixed-up path only: a += 2 included at k is k.a = ${?k.a} [2], so the root's unrelated a = [1] is not appended to and k.a is [2] — otherwise += in an include would depend on an unrelated root key (lightbend/config#863). The literal reading (fallback) is also_valid: k.a [1, 2]. Unlike 009/011/014, where an optional vanishes without a self-look and the root must still be tried.
